Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** validate the resource code and check for duplicates
*/
declare
 h_rtn_num number := 0;
 h_rtn_num2 number := 0;
 h_operation VARCHAR2(1) := '';
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_item_id');
 check_package_failure;

 /*
 ** check if value in global variable matches with current value
 ** -- global variable is null -> this might be a new record
 ** -- global variable = current value -> user might have changed some other column
 ** -- global variable <> current value -> user has over written a record
 */
-- message( 'G-'|| :global.prev_item_id ); pause;
-- message( 'I-'|| :promotions.item_id ); pause;
 if :global.prev_item_id is not null
 and :promotions.item_id != :global.prev_item_id then
 -- first delete old value
 h_rtn_num := check_duplicate_value(:global.dupl_chk_rg,
 :global.dupl_chk_coldesc,
 :global.prev_item_id || ',',
 'D');
/* h_rtn_num := check_duplicate_value(:global.check_dupl_rg,
 :global.check_dupl_coldesc,
 :global.prev_item_id || ',',
 'D');
*/
-- message( 'd-'|| to_char( h_rtn_num ) ); pause;
 if h_rtn_num = 0 then
 /*
 ** operation is successful, so reset global variable
 */
 :global.prev_item_id := '';
 else
 show_error('9198');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if; 
 end if;

 /*
 ** insert only if new is different from global
 */
 if ( :promotions.item_id != :global.prev_item_id 
 or :global.prev_item_id is null ) then

 /*
 ** check for duplicates first
 */
 h_rtn_num := check_duplicate_value(:global.dupl_chk_rg,
 :global.dupl_chk_coldesc,
 :promotions.item_id || ',',
 'C');

-- message( 'c-'|| to_char( h_rtn_num ) ); pause;

 if h_rtn_num = 99999 then -- major error in rec grp processing
 show_error('9198');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;

 if h_rtn_num = 0 then -- unique entry guranteed, so insert into record group
 h_rtn_num2 := check_duplicate_value(:global.dupl_chk_rg,
 :global.dupl_chk_coldesc,
 :promotions.item_id || ',',
 'U');
-- message( 'u-'|| to_char( h_rtn_num ) ); pause;
 if h_rtn_num2 = 0 then
 null; -- success
 elsif h_rtn_num2 = 1 then
 show_error('9199'); -- failure
 check_package_failure;
 else
 message('1:h_rtn_num');
 show_error('9198'); -- internal error
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 elsif h_rtn_num = 1 then
 show_error('11326'); -- Message for duplicate value found
-- show_error('9200'); -- duplicate value found
-- check_package_failure;
 else
 message('2:h_rtn_num');
 show_error('9198'); -- internal error
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;

 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** validate term date
** 1. may be null
** 2. should be a valid future date
** 3. must be later than eff_date
** 4. if being terminated, Check if any drives have this item
** already assigned. If yes give message (no error).
*/
declare
 nCount number;
begin
 if :promotions.term_date is not null then
 if :promotions.term_date < to_date( :ctrl_block.camp_eff_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY' ) then
 show_error('11079');
 check_package_failure;
-- elsif :promotions.term_date > to_date( :ctrl_block.camp_term_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY' ) then
-- show_error('11080');
-- check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :promotions.eff_date > trunc(:promotions.term_date) then
 show_error('11013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :promotions.term_date <= trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('11317');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 /*
 ** To check if there is any drive to which this item was attached
 ** If the count is > 0 then only give a alert message. Allow process.
 */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into nCount
 from drive_campaign_items a, campaign_items b, drives c
 where a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and c.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and b.campaign_id = :promotions.campaign_id
 and b.item_id = :promotions.item_id
 and c.drive_date between :promotions.eff_date and ( :promotions.term_date - 1 )
 and b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
 and c.drive_id = a.drive_id
 and b.item_id = a.item_id;
 if nCount > 0 then
 show_error( '11328' );
-- message( 'Msg: One or more drives have this item atached to it' ); pause;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 null;
 end;
 end if; 

exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('0022');
 check_package_failure;
-- show_error('9191');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUPLICATE_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_duplicate_value(
 recgrp_name varchar2, -- record group name
 column_desc varchar2, -- column definition for record group
 data_string varchar2, -- actual value
 operation_mode VARCHAR2) -- operation abbv.
RETURN number IS
 h_rtn_number number := 0;
 rg_id RECORDGROUP;
BEGIN
 /*
 ** first check if all parameters are not null and have valid value
 */
 if recgrp_name is null then
 show_error('9194');
 elsif column_desc is null then
 show_error('9195');
 elsif data_string is null then
 show_error('9196');
 elsif operation_mode is null or 
 operation_mode not in ('A', 'U', 'D', 'C') then
 show_error('9197');
 else
 rg_id := find_group(recgrp_name);
 if id_null(rg_id) then
 show_error('9193');
 end if;
 end if;

 /*
 ** things are fine, so proceed
 */

 check_insert_rg(recgrp_name, 
 column_desc,
 data_string,
 operation_mode,
 h_rtn_number);

 return h_rtn_number; -- return the value returned by the procedure

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INITIATE_DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this procedure is designed as a wrapper to create_rg proc, which creats
** record group for duplicate check, and is very dumb 'cause no error check.
** but anyways this wrapper gives me enuf control.
**
** h_status is a out variable which is set to null if everythings goes well
** else it is set to an error number, and returned, this helps me in putting
** exit form at one place.
*/

procedure initiate_dup_check 
 ( recgrp_name IN varchar2, -- record group name to be created
 column_desc IN varchar2, -- column definition for rec group
 h_status OUT varchar2) -- return status, null if success, else
 -- holds error number to be displayed
IS
 rg_id RECORDGROUP;
BEGIN
 /*
 ** check record group name and column desc for null things
 ** if everything is okay, then check if record group was created
 ** successfully, return true else return false
 */

 if recgrp_name is null then
 h_status := '9194'; -- set h_status to error message
 elsif column_desc is null then
 h_status := '9195'; -- set h_status to error message
 else
 h_status := '';
 /*
 ** create record group
 */
 create_rg(recgrp_name, column_desc);
 rg_id := find_group(recgrp_name);
 if id_null(rg_id) then
 h_status := '9193'; -- set h_status to error message
 else
 h_status := ''; -- creation is successful, so set to null;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SANITY_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE sanity_check IS
 curr_rec varchar2(10);
 curr_item_id campaign_items.item_id%TYPE;
 curr_eff_date campaign_items.eff_date%TYPE;
 curr_term_date campaign_items.term_date%TYPE;
BEGIN
 go_block( 'promotions' );
 first_record;
 loop -- Outer
 curr_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 curr_item_id := :promotions.item_id;
 curr_eff_date := :promotions.eff_date;
 curr_term_date := :promotions.term_date;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 loop -- Inner
-- message( :system.cursor_record ); pause;
 if :system.cursor_record != curr_rec then
 if curr_item_id = :promotions.item_id then
 if ( curr_term_date is null 
 and :promotions.term_date is null ) then
 show_error( '11327' );
-- message( 'Msg: Only one term date null allowed' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
/*
 message( to_char( :promotions.eff_date ) ); pause;
 message( to_char( :promotions.term_date ) ); pause;
 message( to_char( curr_eff_date ) ); pause;
 message( to_char( curr_term_date ) ); pause;
*/
 if :promotions.eff_date >= curr_eff_date
 and :promotions.eff_date < curr_term_date then
 show_error( '11327' );
-- message( 'Msg: Date Range violation 1' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :promotions.term_date > curr_eff_date
 and :promotions.term_date < curr_term_date then
 show_error( '11327' );
-- message( 'Msg: Date Range violation 2' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if curr_eff_date >= :promotions.eff_date
 and curr_eff_date < :promotions.term_date then
 show_error( '11327' );
-- message( 'Msg: Date Range violation 3' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if curr_term_date > :promotions.eff_date
 and curr_term_date < :promotions.term_date then
 show_error( '11327' );
-- message( 'Msg: Date Range violation 4' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop; -- Inner
 go_record( curr_rec );
 next_record;
 end loop; -- Outer
END;

and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
